title: Appraisal Order Update Visit Charge Calculation
content:
**Appraisal Order update visit charge — calculation.**

(a) *When charged.* A Form 1004D update by the original appraiser keeps the report usable, and its update visit is charged under this rule, when the report's age, in calendar days from the inspection date to the closing date currently scheduled on the loan file, is above the report type's validity days and no more than its maximum age with an update; a report inside its validity days needs no update and is charged nothing under this rule, and a report past its maximum age with an update is replaced by a new order. The loan file is the Mortgage Loan File the Appraisal Order supports, and the closing date read is the one it currently shows as scheduled.

(b) *Orders never charged.* An order placed as an HPML flip second appraisal is never charged an update visit.

(c) *Amount.* The standard update visit charge is the report type's reinspection fee, charged once for the visit. The update visit charge is that amount, kept to the cent.

### Age test and amount — worked cases
Hypothetical inputs: a report type with validity of 120 days, a maximum age with an update of 365 days and a reinspection fee of 175.00 dollars.

| Inspection date to scheduled closing date | Inside validity? | Within maximum with update? | Update visit charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 100 days | Yes | — | 0.00 — no update needed |
| 120 days | Yes (at the limit) | — | 0.00 |
| 121 days | No | Yes | 175.00 |
| 365 days | No | Yes (at the limit) | 175.00 |
| 366 days | No | No | 0.00 under this rule — the report is replaced by a new order |

For a report type whose maximum age with an update is 0, no age is both above the validity days and no more than the maximum, so no update visit is charged. An order placed as an HPML flip second appraisal is charged 0.00 in every row.
